svg.title: One-second partitioned solder-block setup and result
svg.desc: A fixed-bottom, top-shear, traction-free-side 0.1 millimetre SAC305 block on a checked 20 by 20 plane-strain mesh is driven through a minus 40 to 125 to minus 40 degree Celsius cycle. Its retained cycle-2 temperature history and two unsmoothed accumulated element-mean inelastic-energy fields compare quasisteady and backward-Euler lumped-temperature treatments. Field colors share one scale; temperature is uniform by construction, and end-cycle deformation is magnified ten times.
svg.text: One-second solder block: setup and result
0.1 mm SAC305 plane strain · 20 × 20 Quad4 · bottom fixed · top mismatch shear · sides free · -40 / 125 / -40 °C
Accumulated dW · geometry ×10 · top uₓ prescribed
Slow-cycle top-row control · 1,600 s: 0.197122 vs 0.197003 MPa (-0.0605%)
Selected single mesh; not convergence evidence, a spatial thermal field, monolithic φ–T–u solve, crack/life prediction, or measured-device result.
